newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar eases in subdued, routine trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar eases in subdued, routine trade.

text.p: LIFFE sugar eased in subdued trade, with AA trades making up much of volume, traders said.
"It's all routine business," one trader said.
By 1035 GMT front month August was 60 cents lower at $318.50. But August volume was just eight lots. Of the total 57 lots done, October dominated, with 47 lots. It last traded $1.0 lower at $314.50.
On Monday, New York sugar futures closed weaker and under support amid local selling and a lack of buying interest, market sources said.
